scope: Theorem 13.2 (Peanosphere and interval surfaces) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 164. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The following statements hold at γ = √ 2. 1. A γ-quantum cone decorated by an independent space-filling SLE8 curve η, subsequently parameterized by µh-area with η(0) = 0, has a bilateral boundary-length process Z = (L, R) with independent Brownian coordinates. The process determines the decorated quantum surface up to its conformal coordinate equivalence. 2. For the ordinary unit-area sphere, the corresponding area-parameterized curve has duration one, with η(0) = η(1), and its boundary-length process consists of two independent Brownian excursions. It determines the decorated sphere. 3. On the cone, for a deterministic finite interval [a, b], the restricted increments (Zt − Za)a≤t≤b determine the abstract quantum surface η([a, b]), its restricted curve, and its incoming and outgoing boundary arcs with their quantum lengths. The determination is modulo conformal maps. Abstract decorated surfaces from disjoint bilateral intervals are independent. For the sphere, the same reconstruction holds on [δ, 1 − δ] for every fixed 0 < δ < 1/2, with its excursion increment law.
